content: Yesus no umedu bona ege jayaiha.
O baabo gane, ji hilou beele tere malalamudu letigene waha ege ninatege jaimu tagon boni ononi. Tere hilou beele beha teiha, onodu tere waha langa danga oto-otoya.
Onodu tere hilou beele ji malalamudu letigene waha danga bagu yaasu bonade wonga, hilou beele waha langanga Itou no tere ege gidu hatige-hatigena. Wa tere huwanyatege ewe ngalengawei uwa wonga.
Ngalenga beele anyakaro ji amina tigene, beele waha ji yage amina teneha waha. Wa benou. Kristus no ere ebere une oruwanga uulu hagei nomo bona umaiha, Itou nomo buk langa beele inyina dorofe.
Ono wainga nere matmat langa tafa tuwanenga, fati eei langa no ege gidu jayaiha, Itou nomo beele buk langa inyina dorofe.
Onodu bona iinga no Pita langa heigai, onodu bona iinga gainga ege nere aposel 12 langa heigaiha.
Ono wanenga iinga nere baabo gane baingaro nere gaara uraneha, nebere lelege nigou wa 500 feiyawou. Nere baabo gane waha nebere gane baingaro ila gai yafade, ila nere umeru waneha.
Ono wanenga iinga Jems no ege uraiha. Ono wainga iinga gainga nere aposel oruwanga ege uraneha.
Onodu gai huunta nere oruwa mogonege langa ji agefe langa fere heigaiha. Ji magana anya bisi nyabul tuna dorofe.
Ji nere aposel gamanege langa gai menakele. Onodu nere fai ji aposel hiyei nomo edo uwa, taate bona, ji amugedu Itou nomo sios inyabamu nigene.

Ono wene wa Itou no ji bona aau warainga no ji ono hiyainga ji fai elebe yafani beha heigeneha. Onodu no ji bona, nomo aau warou waha ewe uwawei uwa. Gai uwanga uwa. Ji haruwe gai danga bagu teboni, aposel ila feiya nigi-nigini. Onou wa ji yagewe haruwe waha tei uwa. Itou no ji bona aau warainga haruwe waha tei nomo bona danga hiyaiha.
Onou wa, ji ononi yo uwa nere aposel ilawe onode, wa ere oruwanga Yesus no umedu bona ege gidu jayai waha nomo beele malalamudu leleya. Ono geyenga tere isidu boya huwanyatege ngalengana.
Iinga huunta langa nere fai oruwanga umeru wane waha ege jayodbode.
Ere gai-gai Kristus no umainga Itou no ege jaimu tuwai beele waha malalamudu le‑leya. Onoya wa tere gamatege langa nere ila adadu bona benou le‑lede, “Nere fai umerude waha ege ada jayodbode?”
Ngalenga nere fai umerude waha ege ada jayode wage wa, ere benou lewedege, “Itou no Kristus ege jaimu tuwei uwa.”
Onodu Itou no ngalenga Kristus ege jaimu tuwei uwa wage wa, beele ere malalamudu le‑leya waha no dada ewe, onodu tere tebere huwanyatege ngalengawou waha fere no dada ewe.

Onou wage wa, ere fai nere Itou no dada onowai waha bode yaawa beele lelede fai dorofe heigedege. Taate bona, ere Itou no Kristus ege jaimu tuwai waha boya, ere beele tigini foomudu lewei. Onou wa Itou no ngalenga nere fai umerude waha ege ada jaimu nigi-nigina wage, no Kristus fere ege jaimu tuwei uwa.
Yoo, Itou no ngalenga nere fai umerude waha ada jaimu nigi-nigina wonga, ere benou lewei nomo, “Itou no Kristus jaimu tuwei uwa.”
Onodu Itou no ngalenga Kristus ege jaimu tuwei uwa wonga, wa tere tebere huwanyatege ngalengawou ada hoyo tigonbona. Tere tebere une langa gai yafaya.
Onodu nere fai Kristus bode huwanyanege ngalengadu bode umeru wane waha nere fere yae wane.

Ere Kristus boya huwanyage ngalengadu no figinini higei nomo itari tuya. Onou wa, ere agege auma nomo dada elebe oula beha langa tei nomo itariwei mata woya wa, ngalenga ere agege gami bagu tigini, ere oula beha nomo fai ila agenege gami bagu yafade waha feiya nigou.
Ariya onou uwa. Kristus no umainga, Itou no ngalenga tigini ege jaimu tuwaiha. No nere fai ila umeru wane waha amuge nigidu jayaiha, no haga langa da amugedu mumuna dorofe.
Fai ete no umei nomo fanyimu heigemu wainga, fai ete no ege gidu jayei nomo fanyimu heigemu waiha.
Wa benou. Nere fai oruwanga Adam nomo gane waha nere umeru-umerude. Onou dorofenga, nere fai oruwanga Kristus nomo gane waha nere agenege auma yafou todbode.
Onou wa, ere oruwanga ege jaidu boya agege auma yafou ebere saini langa toboya. Amugou wa Kristus. Onodu iinga, saini no ege gidu mona langa, ere nomo fai-aita bagu oruwanga ege gidu jayoboya.

Saini waha langa dada oruwanga usu wonbona. Onodu Kristus no gabman oruwanga usumu nigi bona, hauri danga bagu oruwanga usumu nigi bona dada danga bagu-bagu fere oruwanga usumu wonbona, onodu bona huuna langa yafou waha Jijei Itou owo langa tafonbona.
Taate bona, Kristus no king yafa gonga goi saini no nomo honggoro fai oruwanga ilei nigona langa edo wonbona.
No honggoro fai ila oruwanga usumu nigi borowai, ariya no umou fere usumu wonbona.

Itou nomo buk no benou lena, “Itou no dada oruwanga nomo huuna langa logosiwai otode.” Beele waha no benou lena, Itou no nogowe dada waha oruwanga Kristus nomo huuna langa logosiwei nomo bona haruwe taiha. Onou waha bona ere alai, Itou no nogo Kristus nomo huuna langa yafei uwa.

Onodu iinga gonga, saini dada oruwanga Kristus nomo huuna langa inyi boro gonga, Itou Nomo Idau no nogowe Itou nomo huuna langa tafa tuwonbona. Amugedu Itou no dada oruwanga nomo Idau nomo huuna langa logosiwaiha, onou wa saini Itou Nomo Idau no nogowe Itou nomo huuna langa tafa tugonga, Itou no dada oruwanga nebere mora tigini yafonbona.

Onou wa nere fai umeru wane waha ege ada jayode wage ariya taate hugu bode tigini nere fai umeru wane waha hoyo nigei nomo yaage bisou te‑tede? Nere ege ada gidu jayei mata wode wonga, taate bode fai nere hoyo nigei nomo yaage bisou te‑tede?

Onodu ere bona wa adadu? Fai baingaro nere haruwe ere teya beha bode honggoro higi bode, nere gai-gai inyabamu higode ono-onode. Ariya ere taate bona fai-aita bagu nere fai umane waha ege jayodbode waha lenigi boya golowoya?

Oo baabo gane, ji ngalenga tigini leni, ji fati oruwa isi-isini wa ji umeneha dorofe. Ere oruwanga Yesus Kristus langa yafaya waha boni, ji tere boni edega-edegani, onou waha boni ji beele beha tere huwarimu tigei uwa.

Tere ninatege benou isei mata bonade, ji haruwe beha ji yage yame gauwou oojo boni haruwe teni wonga, tere ji lehiyagu. Ji taate dada tei nomo ninafe isidu boni kaafa kui bagu Efesus langa wara weyeha? Nere fai umeru wane waha ege ada jayei nomo wage, hilobainga “ere da nyi boya yaage nyei nomo, taate bona, iragonga ere umeru woboya.”
Tere fai ila adai awa nigadenga yaawa tigode. Tere beele beha alai, “Ere fai inyaba bagu fadawei mata woya wa, nere ebere onowou hilobainga waha inyabamu hagodbode.”

Tere dabu tayou fanyitege waha awadu bonade ninatege tigini isiagu. Tere une ege adai tafagu. Tere isagu. Tere tebere gane ila nere Itou bode isegu uwa. Ji beele leni beha tere isidu, tebere fanyitege bona edo mayau tigonbona.
Genege gala ege jayona waha no hogo ferete.
Fai ete no benou isoki wona rute, “Nere fai umeru wane waha ege adadu jayode? Saini nere ege jayode langa nere genege gala adoha?”
Wa taate beele nyabuluwou onou? Ne alai, saini ne wit fatu dada tataruni waha, wit fatu waha no ngasunga umedu bona ege ago auma tonbona.
Onodu wit fatu ne tatarini waha edo no wit fatu yo dada ete, no ewe wit fatunga, onodu no nomo urou wa no wit dada iinga heigona dorofe uwa.

Onodu no nogo nomo gauwou langa, Itou no dada uwei hogo fere-fere oruwanga, jiigu bagu nauge dada tuwa bagu osoka bagu gala dada nigi-nigina, wa nere nebere genege gala elegede dorofe. Onou waha bona, nere oruwanga genege gala hogo fere-fere elege-elegede.
Genege gala hogo etenga uwa. Fai oruwa nere genege gala hogo etenga, ono ganga, kaafa nebere genege gala no fere, neei nere genege gala no fere, nere hoowe genege gala no fere.

Onodu taene nomo dada nere genege gala hogo fere‑fere, onodu oula nomo dada fere nere genege gala no fere. Ariya taene nomo dada, nebere mujari wa hogo etenga, oula nomo dada nebere mujari wa hogo fere-fere.
Hoonga nomo mujari hogo etenga, ole nomo mujari hogo fere, onodu baatu nere nebere mujari no hogo fere. Onodu barara etenga-etenga fere nere nage nebere mujari hogo fere-fere.
Nere fai umedu ege jaide waha nebere onowou onounga. Geege gala ere u-u taniya waha no inyaba‑inyabana. Geege gala ege gidu jaina waha no inyabawei nomo edo uwa.
Geege gala u-u taniya waha no dada inyaba. Geege gala ege jaina waha no dada hilobainga tigini. Geege gala ere u-u taniya waha no danga uwau, geege gala no ege jaina waha no danga bagu.
Geege gala ere u-u taniya waha no oula nomo. Ariya geege gala ege jaina waha, no ha laluwa nomo. Oula nomo geege gala bagu, ha laluwa nomo fere geege gala bagu.
Itou nomo buk no benou lena, “Amugou fai Adam, no ago auma taiha.” Ono wainga Adam ete gai huunta heigai waha, no fai agenege auma nigei nomo hauri heigaiha.
Agege auma nomo hauri no amugedu ada heige-heigena. Oula beha nomo agege auma yafou no amugedu heige-heigena. Ono ganga hauri nomo ago auma yafou waha no iinga huunta heige-heigena.
Adam amugou no oula beha nomo, Itou no oula langanga tafa tuwaiha. Onodu Adam huuntaha waha no ha laluwa nomo.
Nere oulaha fai oruwanga nere oula nomo fai waha dorofenga. Onodu nere fai ha laluwa nomo waha oruwanga fai ha laluwaha dorofenga heigodbode.
Elebe ere oulaha fai waha dorofenga yafaya, onou dorofenga iinga gonga ere ha laluwaha fai waha dorofe yafoboya.

Oo baabo gane, ji tere ngalenga letigini, oula beha nomo fai no Itou nomo huuna langa yafou waha huwanya langa ada goidu bona, nomo dada hilou-hilou elegonbona. Onodu dada inyabawei nomo waha, no dada ada inyaba wona waha nomo dada ada elegonbona.
Tere isagu. Ji huwari beele ete malalmudu letigon boni. Ere oruwanga ada umoya. Ere oruwanga ubuludu hogo ferete heigo boya.

Waha no saini bigul hu fosokowou langa bolou gonga, no fasadu heigonbona. Yo, bigul bolou gonga, nere fai umeru wane waha jaidu bode, nere ege ada inyaba wodbode. Ono gogonga ere fai umeruwei uwa waha, ubuludu boya hogo ferete heigoboya.
Wa benou. Geege gala inyabana waha, no ubuludu bona hilou gai-gai inyonbona. Geege gala ume-umena waha, no ubuludu bona no ago auma gai-gai inyonbona.

Ngalenga, geege gala inyabana waha, no ubuludu bona hilobainga gai-gai inyonbona. Onodu geege gala ume-umena waha, no ubuludu bona gai-gai ago auma inyonbona. Saini waha langa Itou nomo buk langa beele inyina waha no tigini onou heigonbona. Itou nomo buk no benou lena, “Itou no oota feiyadu bona umou tigini usumu dewaiha.
Umou, ne fai ilei nigei nomo name danga alanga inyina? Umou, ne fai inyabamu nigei nomo name ganya alanga inyina?”
Umei nomo ganya wa unenga, onodu une no danga nuuni beele langa tetena.
Onou wa ere Itou hilobainga tuwoboya. Ere ebere Anyakaro Yesus Kristus nomo danga langa, Itou no ere hoyo higiganga ere oota feiya-feiyaya.

Onou waha bona, tere yame baabo gane tigini, tere danga bagu oto bonade, menanga adai gurutu wagu. Tere benou isagu, tere Anyakaro boya haruwe danga teya waha no ewe ada usu wonbona. Onou waha bona tere gai-gai Anyakaro nomo haruwe danga bagu tefu wagu.
